projects.title: Body Ops
projects.summary: Every signal from your phone, watch and logs on one Grafana dashboard, updated every hour.
projects.description: Marrow's automations send health metrics, raw heart rate and sleep stages, workouts, the strength log and the food diary to a small bridge that writes them into InfluxDB. Grafana shows a year of heart rate by the hour, sleep stages and bed and wake times, resting heart rate and HRV, steps, food by macro and by meal, training volume by muscle and estimated one rep maxes. Docker Compose, with a demo mode that fills it with made-up data.

projects.title: A Year in Rings
projects.summary: One picture of a year: heart rate, sleep, steps, calories, sound and daylight as six clock rings, from Body Ops data.
projects.description: Six ring charts in one image. Each ring is a day, oldest in the middle. Each slice is an hour, midnight at the top. The color is that hour's value. Heart rate, steps, calories burned, sound and daylight come from Marrow's raw samples, and sleep is one arc per night from falling asleep to waking up. One Python script reads the Body Ops InfluxDB and writes a page that draws the picture and saves it as a PNG.
